notice.new: New menu: save it before publishing
notice.unpublished: There are unpublished changes: fans still see the menu published last
notice.draft: Not published yet: fans do not see this menu

menu.conditionalHint: A conditional menu matches a fan tag or a client platform and can be published once the default menu is
menu.empty: No menus yet: add the default menu, or pull the current one from WeChat
menu.matchHint: Choose at least one match condition
menu.tagNeedsBrowse: Matching a tag also needs the permission to view tags (fan management); ask an administrator
menu.pickButton: Select or add a button in the phone preview
menu.parentHint: A button with sub-buttons only needs a name; remove all its sub-buttons to give it a kind
menu.keyHint: WeChat sends this KEY when a fan taps the button; click reply rules match on it
menu.miniprogramUrlHint: Older WeChat clients without mini program support open this web page
menu.legacy: This button kind is retired: it can only be kept as it is or removed
menu.fixErrors: Please fix the marked problems first
menu.discardConfirm: The custom menu “{label}” has unsaved changes. Discard them?

publish.confirm: Fans' WeChat clients may take a few minutes to show the new menu (following again shows it at once). Publish now?

remove.confirmLive: Delete the menu “{label}”? It is published and will be removed from WeChat as well.

pull.confirm: The account's live menus will replace their local counterparts (the default menu and each conditional menu WeChat still has); their unpublished changes are lost, and so are unsaved changes. Local menus WeChat does not have stay as unpublished drafts. Pull now?

skipped.no_match: Pulled; {count} conditional menu(s) matching neither a tag nor a platform could not be imported
skipped.invalid: Pulled; {count} menu(s) with buttons or a match rule this system cannot hold could not be imported

clear.confirm: Every live menu of the account (conditional ones included) will be deleted and fans will see no menu. Clear now?

tryMatch.title: Test menu matching
tryMatch.hint: Enter a fan's openid or WeChat ID to see the menu WeChat shows that fan
